name: Why can't I clean up black water myself?

mainEntity.name: Why can't I clean up black water myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning black water yourself is extremely dangerous and not recommended. Black water is a biohazard filled with disease-causing bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens that can lead to severe health issues, including infections, gastrointestinal illnesses, and respiratory problems. Without proper personal protective equipment (PPE), specialized tools, and professional disinfectants, you risk exposure and the spread of contaminants. Professionals are trained to safely remove, dispose of, and disinfect affected areas to prevent lingering health hazards and secondary damage like mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleaning black water yourself is dangerous due to severe health risks from pathogens. Professionals have the necessary PPE, tools, and disinfectants to safely remove contaminants and prevent further issues.
